blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines–Jeff Lumbo turned the back nine of the Sta. Barbara layout upside down on Thursday as he went on to fire an eight-under-par 62 to grab a three-shot lead over Jonel Ababa and Francis Morilla with a round left in the P2.5 million ICTSI Iloilo Golf Challenge. The weather changed so many times in the third round that made the tree-lined, age-old layout play even more difficult, but Lumbo was not to be denied as he gunned down six of his nine birdies coming home for a 28 and a 200 aggregate after 54 holes as second round leader Miki […]...
